name: CI-infra fix: verify:no-duplicate-routes dist/ availability

changes.summary: Changed distRoot default from dist/ to apps/backend/src/, autoloadRoot from dist/accounting to apps/backend/src/accounting. Updated file filter from .routes.js/.js to .routes.ts/.ts. Renamed --dist-root CLI flag to --src-root. Updated error message to say 'src root'.
Updated fixture paths from positive/dist and negative/dist to positive/src and negative/src to match new source-based check.
New fixture: single autoload route plugin with no manual re-registration (positive/clean case).
New fixture: autoload route plugin for negative case.
New fixture: manually re-registers the same route function, creating the deliberate duplicate that the guard must catch.

acceptance.check: VERIFIED 2026-08-01: the manifest's described src-based migration (distRoot->apps/backend/src, autoloadRoot->apps/backend/src/accounting, .routes.js/.js -> .routes.ts/.ts, --dist-root -> --src-root) had NEVER actually been applied to scripts/verify-no-duplicate-routes.mjs — it still defaulted to dist/ and required npm run build:backend first. The test fixtures at scripts/__tests__/fixtures/no-duplicate-routes/{positive,negative}/src already existed in TS form but scripts/__tests__/verify-no-duplicate-routes.test.mjs still pointed at nonexistent positive/dist + negative/dist, so the negative (duplicate-detection) test was silently finding 0 files and failing. Completed the migration: script now reads apps/backend/src directly (no dist/ build required), with a relative-to-root isExcludedFromBuild() check mirroring apps/backend/tsconfig.json's test excludes (.test.ts, .integration.test.ts, .deprecated.ts, __tests__/) so it never false-positives on route-like code in tests. node --test scripts/__tests__/verify-no-duplicate-routes.test.mjs -> 2/2 pass (positive AND negative fixtures both correctly resolved); node scripts/verify-no-duplicate-routes.mjs -> OK (no dist/ required) against the live apps/backend/src tree.
acceptance.evidence: node --test scripts/__tests__/verify-no-duplicate-routes.test.mjs -> 2 pass, 0 fail; node scripts/verify-no-duplicate-routes.mjs -> 'verify:no-duplicate-routes OK (no dist/ required)'.

evidence_note: NV-29-CLOSE 2026-06-26: allowed_files backfilled with verified on-main artifacts (registry was blank; feature already built). 2026-08-01: 'already built' claim was FALSE — script still dist-based; migration actually completed this pass, see acceptance[0].
